reply.text: {"say":"Back thickness it is: the session is built mostly on rows, opening with heavy barbell work, then chest-supported and cable angles, with one pulldown to round it out and shrugs to finish the upper back.","title":"Back Thickness","days":[{"name":"Back Thickness","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull to the lower ribs.\n\n"},{"key":"dumbbell-chest-supported-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top"},{"key":"close-grip-cable-seated-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause one second with handle at stomach"},{"key":"single-arm-dumbbell-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive elbow toward the hip"},{"key":"neutral-grip-cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":""},{"key":"dumbbell-shrug","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hold the top for a second"}]}],"unmet":[]}
